description:
Create a new payroll timesheet in Xero.
This allows you to specify details such as the employee ID, payroll calendar ID, start and end dates, and timesheet lines.

endDate.description: The end date of the timesheet period (YYYY-MM-DD).

payrollCalendarID.description: The ID of the payroll calendar.

startDate.description: The start date of the timesheet period (YYYY-MM-DD).

date.description: The date for the timesheet line (YYYY-MM-DD).

earningsRateID.description: The ID of the earnings rate.

numberOfUnits.description: The number of units for the timesheet line.

name: create-timesheet
